tasks.title: Dashboard
tasks.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Asset: a high-fidelity COLOR CONCEPT board for the existing House Finance Tracker, not a redesign. Make one large clean landscape raster board with two aligned views: the actual desktop layout on the left, a narrower phone viewport on the right. Crisp readable Inter typography, flat frontal UI, no physical device shells, no perspective, no fake branding. Small outside-the-UI heading and labels 'Desktop' and 'Mobile'; a compact labeled palette swatch row below. Every input screenshot is an actual synthetic-fixture application reference. Image 1 is the desktop page/layout reference; image 2 is the mobile page/layout reference. Change ONLY color styling and modest decorative icon/header accents. Preserve all existing layout proportions, panels, spacing, text and monetary signs, controls, chart data meaning, routes and icons. No new features, no new banking/payment function, no dark mode or Credits. No invented category filters or currency switches. Do not move cards/panels. Crop the phone to a normal first viewport, rather than miniaturizing its whole long scrolling page. Preserve continuation content as existing offscreen content.
Unified proposed palette: existing pearl-gray canvas #E2E6EB and near-white #F9FAFC; visible richer periwinkle/indigo accent #5668CF, pale periwinkle #DCE4FF, supporting teal #217B75 and soft mint #E0F2EC, restrained warm amber #E6AA3D and cream #FFF1CE; black text/primary pills #080909. These accent colors must be VISIBLE in select summary panels, existing section-header bands, icon discs and selected-field accents, with white space retained. Never paint every card a different saturated hue. Black selected nav pills and black primary buttons MUST remain black. Desktop glass only on center Dashboard-through-Household capsule and compact sidebar; logo/bell/profile ordinary. Mobile dock must match the rounded floating translucent glass dock in the approved dashboard reference, with five original icons Dashboard/Expenses/Add/Settlements/More, black active pill and periwinkle Add. No hover state shown. Financial meanings remain labeled: green positive/get-back, red negative/owe/error, amber Pending, zero neutral. Monetary numbers stay black except signed balance pills. Do not use decorative teal to imply completed payment.
Keep every financial fact unchanged from references; omit rather than invent unreadable small copy. Main page controls can continue below viewport; omissions are illustrative, not a changed product. Remove the development-only wrench from the concept. The result should clearly look like the SAME app made more colorful, not a generic new blue banking dashboard.
Page: Dashboard. Retain August 2026, Household Summary, Spent ৳450.00, Outstanding You Owe ৳0.00 / You Are Owed ৳200.00, member contributions Raiyan 300 and John 150, signed housemate balances +200/-175/-25, Settlement Health outstanding1/pending1, Recent Expenses and Cash/Card Payment Mix. Give the Spent panel a visible soft periwinkle fill, Contributions soft mint, Pending tile soft amber, and charts a coherent indigo/teal categorical palette. Mobile keeps the actual stacked/collapsible modules and centered month control; apply the same tints above the fold. No extra trend percentages or new CTA.
